title: Grimtide's Rising Flood
story: The sea monster Grimtide is flooding the old lighthouse where 3 children are trapped on a ledge 36 feet above the water! The water rises 4 feet every minute. Mr 6 leaps into his rowboat — he needs 7 minutes of hard rowing to reach them.
question: How many minutes to spare will Mr 6 have when he reaches the children?
hint: First: how many minutes until the water reaches 36 feet, rising 4 feet per minute? Then compare that to Mr 6's 7-minute row.
victory: With 2 minutes to spare, Mr 6 sweeps all three children into the boat! Furious, Grimtide slaps the water so hard he launches the boat like a wave-ski — fastest rescue ride ever, straight to shore.
solution: The water rises 4 feet each minute, so reaching 36 feet takes 36 / 4 = 9 minutes.
Mr 6's row takes 7 minutes, so compare: 9 - 7 = 2.
Mr 6 reaches the children with 2 minutes to spare.
praise: Dividing to find the flood time was the right instinct — one step was missing: subtracting the 7-minute row.
